Template '''''GVI''''' standing for '''''G'''ame '''V'''ersion '''I'''con'' - must appear inline {{GVI|arma3|1.00}} when in a paragraph.

It places the page in the [[:Category:GVI template usage error|GVI template usage error]] category if no game is provided.

== Usage ==
{{<nowiki/>GVI|'''''game'''''|'''''version'''''|'''''size='''''}}
* game: identical to [[Template:Name|Name Identifiers]]
* version: (Optional) game version such as "1.75", "1.5.0", etc
** default {{hl|1.00}} for games from {{ofp}} up until {{arma3}}/{{dayz}} - '''two digits''' after the period
** default {{hl|1.0.0}} since {{armaR}}
* branch: (Optional, named parameter, default empty) can be {{hl|dev}} or {{hl|diag}} for Development or Diagnostic Branch
* size: (Optional, named parameter, default {{hl|1}}) ratio size, ratio &times; 32px
